title: Review: Fine, let's talk about Digger
gist: A positive review of the film Digger, directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu and starring Tom Cruise, which has bombed with about $20 million globally in its opening weekend against a budget of $125 million or more, while the reviewer defends it as an audacious, polarizing film with cult potential.

insights.claim: Digger earned about $20 million globally in its opening weekend against a budget of $125 million or possibly more, and is on track to be one of the year's biggest bombs.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Large-budget auteur release underperforming is a negative data point for Warner Bros.' film slate.

insights.claim: The reviewer blames the studio's miscalculation: the modest take would be solid by arthouse standards if not for the hefty budget, and marketing it as an arthouse film might have tempered expectations.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Budget-to-audience mismatch drives the loss, not necessarily quality.
insights.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Digger might boast an A-list star'

insights.claim: Digger has sharply polarized critics and audiences, with some praising Iñárritu's bold swings and others finding it practically unwatchable.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Divisive reception limits word-of-mouth and awards prospects.

insights.claim: The reviewer considers Tom Cruise's performance Oscar-worthy and on par with Magnolia, though critical backlash could dash his chances.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Awards outlook for the film is uncertain given reception.

insights.claim: The reviewer predicts Digger may become a cult classic like Blade Runner, a film that was also a critical and financial bomb.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Long-tail library value is possible but speculative.
insights.quote: Only time will tell, but I suspect Digger might join their ranks.

insights.claim: Digger is closer to absurdist theater than satire, with a twist revealing the story is a play within the film about a hated oil executive, set 25 years after a global climate catastrophe.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Context for the film's climate-themed content.

insights.claim: Digger was initially developed at Netflix with Leonardo DiCaprio as a possible star, but Netflix chose to make Don't Look Up with him instead, and Cruise's interest then revived the project.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Production history shows how projects move between studios.
